name: Decompilation & High-Level Analysis
description: Use of decompilers to recover high-level code representations from binaries and bytecode. Covers Hex-Rays, Ghidra decompiler, and bytecode decompilers (jadx, ILSpy or dnSpyEx, JEB). Includes type recovery, variable renaming, signature matching, and validation of decompiler output accuracy.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands decompilation concepts and tool capabilities
evidence: Can explain how decompilers recover high-level code from binaries
Familiar with decompiler output limitations and inaccuracies
Understands the difference between native and bytecode decompilation

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Uses decompilers to analyze simple programs under supervision
evidence: Used Ghidra or Hex-Rays decompiler to analyze native binaries
Decompiled Java (jadx) or .NET (ILSpy or dnSpyEx) applications
Applied type information and renamed variables to improve readability
Work reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently uses decompilers for security analysis and vulnerability identification
evidence: Independently used decompilation on 5+ engagements
Validates decompiler output by cross-referencing with disassembly
Applies FLIRT signatures and type libraries to improve decompiler accuracy
Identifies security vulnerabilities from decompiled code
Passed proficiency assessment on decompilation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex decompilation challenges; corrects decompiler errors
evidence: Manually corrects decompiler output for complex constructs (C++ vtables, inlined functions)
Applies custom type definitions and struct layouts to improve analysis
Decompiles obfuscated and optimized binaries effectively
Mentors junior analysts on decompiler usage and interpretation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on decompilation; extends decompiler capabilities
evidence: Published research on decompilation techniques or improvements
Develops decompiler plugins or processor modules
Contributes to decompiler tooling (Ghidra plugins, Hex-Rays extensions)
Trains teams on advanced decompilation techniques

assessment_methods.description: Decompile a binary application, recover its key algorithms, and identify security vulnerabilities from decompiled output
Review of annotated decompiler output and analysis notes from recent engagements
